rules.description: List of access control rules. Each rule defines when (and for whom) access is allowed or denied.

comment.description: Optional comment line (starts with # or ;). If non-empty, inserted as a standalone comment before the rule.

service.description: PAM service name (e.g., login, sshd). Use '*' for any service.

tty.description: Terminal device pattern (e.g., 'tty1', 'pts/*', '*'). Use '*' for any.

user.description: Username pattern or group (prefixed with '@'). Use '*' for any user/group. Supports wildcards.

time.description: Time specification. Prefix with '!' to deny access during the window; omit to allow. Format: [W]hhmm-[W]hhmm where W=weekday (0=Sun, 6=Sat) or * for any.
